_comment: TRIAL config — Anthropic ONLY, Claude Sonnet 4.6 to keep cost low (founder decision 2026-06-12). Claude Fable 5 is intentionally NOT used (unavailable to the founder). SAMPLER uses the cheapest Claude (Haiku 4.5) for high-volume best-of-N. Accuracy stays paramount via the verifier: a verifier-rejected generation escalates to Opus 4.8 (see _escalation_target) once the escalation ladder is built (ADR-002) — Sonnet is the cheap default, never a quality compromise. Activate: set MODELS_CONFIG_PATH=configs/models.anthropic.json and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in ai_server/.env.
